profile.headline: Software Developer in Test
profile.summary:
Software developer in test with over 8 years of experience planning and leading test automation projects. Wide experience designing automation framework/infrastructure for new automation projects, conducting test execution cycles, logging and tracking application defects. Passionate about building tools and implementing process improvements to address pain points and increase team efficiency. 

Python – 8 years of python development experience

Unit Testing – Well versed in unit testing best practices and a strong proponent of TDD

System Test – Experience planning, executing, and automating end-to-end tests for many features running on embedded linux platforms

CI/CD – Experience developing Jenkins/Gitlab pipelines for code commit process

API Design - Experience designing generic APIs for test automation which use different underlying implementations for different equipment (i.e. test needs to send traffic and should not need to know what type of traffic generator is going to be used)

Automation Framework Development – Experience extending RobotFramework capabilities to do parallel testing with thread safe resource management

Strong Networking Fundamentals  – Prior CCNA certified and 10+ years experience configuring/troubleshooting lab networks

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test II
Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for QA throughout the development lifecycle. This involves regularly testing and giving feedback to developers and also developing the automation framework, tools, and automated test cases. I was also involved in planning, executing, and documenting monthly release testing in TestRail and Confluence.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: SRE responsible for managing/debugging several large (20 VM) customer deployments running docker swarm. Also involved in developing data backup services and building test infrastructure.

positions.title: Senior QA Engineer
positions.description: Core developer for building test automation infrastructure. Responsible for planning, executing, automating tests for the following features: DSG, Lawful Intercept, Virtual Route Forwarding, PCDQoS, SNMP, DOCSIS Load Balancing. Also heavily involved in managing/debugging shared core lab infrastructure.

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer
positions.description: Core developer for building test automation infrastructure. Responsible for planning, executing, automating tests for the following features: DSG, Lawful Intercept, Virtual Route Forwarding, PCDQoS, SNMP, DOCSIS Load Balancing. Also heavily involved in managing/debugging shared core lab infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for developing PHY/MAC features for next generation cBR-8 (Converged Broadband Router). Multi-layer DOCSIS modem troubleshooting. Physical layer debugging with signal analyzers, oscilloscopes, and DOCSIS protocol analyzers.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Pilot sensing of digital TV stations for use in software defined radio in the white spaces band.

Implemented a new theoretical wireless transmission scheme allowing multiple users to transmit data simultaneously without interfering with each other. Implementation done in hardware using National Instruments FlexRIO hardware, programmed in LabVIEW on FPGA and RTOS.

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Analyzed customer-identified software defects using industry standard metrics to find correlations between highly complex programs and the number of high priority bugs.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Designed and implemented secure malware lab for Cisco product R&D
